artifacts.notes: Complete delivered sample image, showing the first strip verso and only part of the second strip verso. Neither all original sides nor the missing whole lectionary was acquired or collated. Visible John/Jeremiah text confirms reading-fragment extent without establishing Ravenna origin or use.
artifacts.rights_basis: Faithful two-dimensional facsimile of public-domain sixth-century handwriting; no separately identified creative modern annotation. Apply the same established United States mechanical-reproduction basis as the already accepted Stuttgart/Montecassino CLA sample images. Attribution: Earlier Latin Manuscripts, University of Galway, CLA IX 1334. No PDM declaration by Galway is invented.
